description: This file is a shell script that contains a comprehensive set of tests for verifying the behavior of 'git repack' functionality. It includes setup routines, various test cases for different options, cleanup procedures, and validation checks, all implemented as shell functions and commands.

methods.name: commit_and_pack
methods.description: Creates a commit and packs objects in the repository, returning the pack filename.

methods.name: test_no_missing_in_packs
methods.description: Verifies that the pack files do not have missing objects.

methods.name: test_has_duplicate_object
methods.description: Checks for duplicate objects in the pack files.

methods.name: test_server_info_present
methods.description: Ensures the server info files are present.

methods.name: test_server_info_missing
methods.description: Ensures the server info files are missing.

methods.name: test_server_info_cleanup
methods.description: Removes server info files and verifies their absence.

methods.name: prepare_for_keep_packs
methods.description: Prepares a repository with packs that are kept for testing filtering and pack-kept-objects options.

methods.name: get_sorted_objects_from_pack
methods.description: Outputs a sorted list of object IDs from a given pack index file.
